BlankPageStatus.description:
Blank page detection status (Spec §7.B).

All statuses remain CROP_READY (non-blocking warning).
BlankPageStatus.title: BlankPageStatus

ClassificationStatus.description:
Layout classification status from the classifier engine (Spec §2, §11).

These represent the outcome of TAHAP 1: In-Memory Layout Classifier Engine.
ClassificationStatus.title: ClassificationStatus

CoverDimensions.description:
Cover target dimensions per specification (Spec §8.A, §14.A.4, §16.1).

Specification defines distinct output dimensions:
- BACKCOVER.jpg: 1890 × 2657 px @ 300 DPI
- COVER.jpg: 630 × 886 px @ 100 DPI

target_backcover_width_px.description: BACKCOVER.jpg target width at 300 DPI (Spec §8.A: 1890 px)
target_backcover_width_px.title: Target Backcover Width Px

target_backcover_height_px.description: BACKCOVER.jpg target height at 300 DPI (Spec §8.A: 2657 px)
target_backcover_height_px.title: Target Backcover Height Px

target_cover_width_px.description: COVER.jpg target width at 100 DPI (Spec §8.A, §14.A.4: 630 px)
target_cover_width_px.title: Target Cover Width Px

target_cover_height_px.description: COVER.jpg target height at 100 DPI (Spec §8.A, §14.A.4: 886 px)
target_cover_height_px.title: Target Cover Height Px

frontcover_height_discrepancy_note.description: Documents the 1 px discrepancy between 3x scaling (2658 px) and vector 300 DPI render (2657 px). Status: UNRESOLVED_ROUNDING_1PX
frontcover_height_discrepancy_note.title: Frontcover Height Discrepancy Note

CoverDimensions.title: CoverDimensions

CropReadinessStatus.description:
Crop execution readiness status from safety guardrails (Spec §2, §11).

These represent the outcome of TAHAP 2: Crop Strategy Router &
Safety Guardrails Validator.
CropReadinessStatus.title: CropReadinessStatus

CropRegion.description:
A single rectangular crop region in PDF coordinate space.

Defines the bounding box [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in points for
one output page, plus target pixel dimensions at the profile DPI.

Coordinate system follows PyMuPDF convention (origin at top-left).

region_id.description: Output filename stem for this region (e.g. 'PAGE-01', 'PAGE-02', 'COVER', 'BACKCOVER')
region_id.title: Region Id

quadrant.description: Quadrant index for 4-Up layout (1=TL, 2=TR, 3=BL, 4=BR). None for non-4-Up.
quadrant.title: Quadrant

x_min_pt.description: Left edge of crop region in points
x_min_pt.title: X Min Pt

y_min_pt.description: Top edge of crop region in points
y_min_pt.title: Y Min Pt

x_max_pt.description: Right edge of crop region in points
x_max_pt.title: X Max Pt

y_max_pt.description: Bottom edge of crop region in points
y_max_pt.title: Y Max Pt

target_width_px.description: Expected output width in pixels at render DPI
target_width_px.title: Target Width Px

target_height_px.description: Expected output height in pixels at render DPI
target_height_px.title: Target Height Px

blank_page_status.description: Blank page detection result (Spec §7.B). Non-blocking warning.

CropRegion.title: CropRegion

CropStrategyType.description: Crop strategy types mapped 1:1 to layout types (Spec §8.B).
CropStrategyType.title: CropStrategyType

CropValidationResult.description:
Result of validating a single crop region against safety rules.

Used to report whether a proposed crop operation is safe to execute
automatically or requires manual review.

pdf_page_index.description: Zero-based page index of the source PDF page
pdf_page_index.title: Pdf Page Index

actual_width_px.description: Actual rendered width in pixels (if computed)
actual_width_px.title: Actual Width Px

actual_height_px.description: Actual rendered height in pixels (if computed)
actual_height_px.title: Actual Height Px

expected_width_px.description: Expected width in pixels from profile target
expected_width_px.title: Expected Width Px

expected_height_px.description: Expected height in pixels from profile target
expected_height_px.title: Expected Height Px

dimension_match.description: Whether actual dimensions match expected (None if not yet computed)
dimension_match.title: Dimension Match

tick_deviation_x_mm.description: Tick mark deviation on X axis in mm (4-Up only)
tick_deviation_x_mm.title: Tick Deviation X Mm

tick_deviation_y_mm.description: Tick mark deviation on Y axis in mm (4-Up only)
tick_deviation_y_mm.title: Tick Deviation Y Mm

tick_within_tolerance.description: Whether tick deviations are within tolerance (≤ 1.0 mm per Spec §6.B)
tick_within_tolerance.title: Tick Within Tolerance

CropValidationResult.title: CropValidationResult

DocumentStatus.description:
Aggregated document-level processing status.

Follows the document-level integrity validation logic from Spec §12.

has_unknown_layout.description: Whether any page has UNKNOWN_LAYOUT classification
has_unknown_layout.title: Has Unknown Layout

has_manual_review_required.description: Whether any page has MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED readiness
has_manual_review_required.title: Has Manual Review Required

all_pages_crop_ready.description: Whether all classified pages have CROP_READY readiness
all_pages_crop_ready.title: All Pages Crop Ready

DocumentStatus.title: DocumentStatus

LayoutType.description: Layout types identified by the classifier (Spec §4, §11).
LayoutType.title: LayoutType

ManualReviewFlag.description:
Flags indicating reason for manual review hold (Spec §2, §6, §8, §11).

Multiple flags may be present on a single page.
ManualReviewFlag.title: ManualReviewFlag

OuterMarginConfig.description:
Outer margin trimming parameters for 4-Up imposition (Spec §10.A, §17).

These are the digital margins trimmed from the 4 outer edges of the
imposition sheet to yield the clean A5 book page dimensions.

horizontal_pt.description: Horizontal outer margin in points (Spec §10.A: 13.85 pt)
horizontal_pt.title: Horizontal Pt

vertical_pt.description: Vertical outer margin in points (Spec §10.A: 14.50 pt)
vertical_pt.title: Vertical Pt

horizontal_mm.description: Horizontal outer margin in mm (Spec §10.A: 4.886 mm)
horizontal_mm.title: Horizontal Mm

vertical_mm.description: Vertical outer margin in mm (Spec §10.A: 5.115 mm)
vertical_mm.title: Vertical Mm

OuterMarginConfig.title: OuterMarginConfig

PageCropPlan.description:
Crop plan for a single PDF page/sheet.

Combines classification results from TAHAP 1 (Layout Classifier)
with crop readiness from TAHAP 2 (Safety Guardrails), and lists
the CropRegion(s) to extract from this page.

pdf_page_index.description: Zero-based page index in the PDF document
pdf_page_index.title: Pdf Page Index

width_pt.description: Page width from page.rect in points
width_pt.title: Width Pt

height_pt.description: Page height from page.rect in points
height_pt.title: Height Pt

rotation.description: PDF page rotation value (0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees)
rotation.title: Rotation

crop_regions.description: List of crop regions to extract from this page
crop_regions.title: Crop Regions

expected_page_yield.description: Number of book pages this sheet produces (Cover=2, 4-Up=4, Single=1, Unknown=0)
expected_page_yield.title: Expected Page Yield

PageCropPlan.title: PageCropPlan

ProjectTrimProfile.description:
Project-level trim configuration profile (Spec §10.A, §15.A).

Defines target output dimensions, margin parameters, and production rules
for the entire project. This is the top-level configuration that governs
all crop operations.

All dimension values originate from the specification's reconciliation
table (§17) and JSON config example (§10.A).

target_content_width_px.description: Target content page width at 300 DPI (Spec §8.B.2: 1773 px)
target_content_width_px.title: Target Content Width Px

target_content_height_px.description: Target content page height at 300 DPI (Spec §8.B.2: 2538 px)
target_content_height_px.title: Target Content Height Px

target_content_width_pt.description: Target content page width in points (Spec §8.B.2: 425.52 pt)
target_content_width_pt.title: Target Content Width Pt

target_content_height_pt.description: Target content page height in points (Spec §8.B.2: 609.12 pt)
target_content_height_pt.title: Target Content Height Pt

cover_dimensions.description: Cover target dimensions and discrepancy tracking

cover_auto_crop_enabled.description: Cover auto-crop production flag (Spec §8.B.1: ALWAYS False). Cover sheets must remain MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
cover_auto_crop_enabled.title: Cover Auto Crop Enabled

outer_margin.description: Outer margin trimming parameters for 4-Up imposition

tick_deviation_tolerance_mm.description: Maximum tick mark deviation tolerance in mm (Spec §6.B: 1.0 mm)
tick_deviation_tolerance_mm.title: Tick Deviation Tolerance Mm

tick_deviation_tolerance_pt.description: Computed: tick_deviation_tolerance_mm converted to points. 1 mm = 2.835 pt (Spec §6.B).
tick_deviation_tolerance_pt.title: Tick Deviation Tolerance Pt

spine_excluded.description: Whether spine zone is excluded from cover crop (Spec §8.B.1)
spine_excluded.title: Spine Excluded

applicable_strategies.description: Crop strategies this profile applies to
applicable_strategies.title: Applicable Strategies

ProjectTrimProfile.title: ProjectTrimProfile

Complete crop plan for an entire PDF document.

Aggregates per-page crop plans and derives document-level status
following the aggregation logic in Spec §12.

total_pdf_pages.description: Total number of pages in the PDF document (Spec §3.B)
total_pdf_pages.title: Total Pdf Pages

profile.description: Project trim profile used for this document

page_plans.description: Ordered list of crop plans for each PDF page
page_plans.title: Page Plans

expected_total_book_pages.description: Total expected book pages from all sheets (Spec §3.B)
expected_total_book_pages.title: Expected Total Book Pages

page_sequence_signature.description: Pattern of layout types per page, e.g. ['COVER_SPREAD', 'IMPOSITION_4UP', ...] (Spec §3.B)
page_sequence_signature.title: Page Sequence Signature

validation_results.description: Validation results for each crop region
validation_results.title: Validation Results
